title: 🗳️ general election — 1st turn
body:
# 🧭 Steps

1. Vote in the 1st turn (president, governors, senators, federal/state deputies) — expect **4 Oct 2026**; confirm the official date.
2. Follow [the voting routine](./election/voting.md) — e-Titulo, in-person vote, or justificativa.

## ✅ Done when

- Voted in 1st turn, or justified absence in e-Titulo
- Deadline bumped to next cycle (2030-10-04)
